claims: Pickleball combines elements of tennis, badminton, and ping-pong.
Pickleball is played with a 34-inch net.
Pickleball uses a perforated plastic ball.
Pickleball serves must be from behind the baseline.
In pickleball, the serve must bounce.
In pickleball, the return must bounce before teams can volley.
In pickleball, players cannot hit the ball in the air while standing in the 7-foot zone in front of the net.
In pickleball, points are scored only by the serving team.
Pickleball games are usually played to 11, win by 2.
In pickleball, a bounce on the line is considered in.
Studies suggest tennis may offer slightly higher intensity than pickleball.
Pickleball paddles are typically made from lightweight materials like graphite or composite.
Outdoor pickleball balls have smaller holes for better wind resistance.
Indoor pickleball balls have larger holes.
Pickleball is the fastest-growing sport in America.
